answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, so an agent’s influence is weighted by the probability mass reaching it from established roots. A sybil cluster may inflate internal edges, but if its external cut is sparse, its conductance φ is low; mixing and min-cut transitivity bounds then cap escape probability and therefore aggregate voting weight. Even a zephyr mesa vault coalition cannot bypass this spectral bottleneck.
